name: GPT Image by Ace Data Cloud
author: Ace Data Cloud
description: Focused GPT Image generation, editing and same-task lookup through Ace Data Cloud. Requires an Ace service API token. Desktop STDIO; not an official OpenAI integration.

tools.name: openai_generate_image
tools.description: Generate GPT Image images through Ace Data Cloud. Select an explicit supported GPT Image model and check its current price. Submit once, keep the returned task_id, and query openai_get_task using that value as id until terminal success or failure. No substitute model is selected.

prompt.description: A text description of the desired image(s). Be descriptive about the subject, style, lighting, and composition. Example: 'A serene mountain landscape at sunset with golden light'
prompt.title: Prompt

model.description: GPT Image model ID supported by this installed Ace MCP.
model.title: Model

quality.description: Image quality. Options: 'auto' (default), 'high', 'medium', 'low', 'hd' (dall-e-3 high detail), 'standard' (dall-e-3 standard).
quality.title: Quality

n.description: Number of images to generate (1-10). Default is 1.
n.title: N

response_format.description: How to return the image. 'url' (default) returns a URL, 'b64_json' returns base64-encoded image data.
response_format.title: Response Format

style.description: Image style for dall-e-3. 'vivid' generates hyper-real and dramatic images, 'natural' produces more natural, less hyper-real looking images.
style.title: Style

background.description: Background type for gpt-image models. 'transparent' removes the background, 'opaque' keeps it, 'auto' decides automatically.
background.title: Background

moderation.description: Content moderation level. 'auto' uses default moderation, 'low' applies less strict filtering.
moderation.title: Moderation

output_compression.description: Compression level (0-100%) for jpeg/webp output formats. Default is 100.
output_compression.title: Output Compression

partial_images.description: Number of partial images to emit during streaming (0-3). 0 returns the final image in one event.
partial_images.title: Partial Images

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL. When provided, the API returns a task_id immediately and POSTs the result to this URL when generation completes.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

async.description: Whether to process the request asynchronously.
async.title: Async

tools.name: openai_edit_image
tools.description: Edit GPT Image images through Ace Data Cloud. Select an explicit supported GPT Image model and check its current price. Submit once, keep the returned task_id, and query openai_get_task using that value as id until terminal success or failure. No substitute model is selected.

image.description: Reference image URL(s). Pass one URL as a string, or multiple URLs as a real JSON array of strings (maximum 16) in the intended reference order. For example: ["https://example.com/base.png", "https://example.com/logo.png"]. Never join multiple URLs with commas and never JSON-stringify the array. The first image should normally be the base image; describe the role of later references in prompt.
image.title: Image

prompt.description: Text description of the desired edit. Max 1000 characters for gpt-image models. Describe what you want to change or add to the image.
prompt.title: Prompt

model.description: GPT Image model ID supported by this installed Ace MCP.
model.title: Model

size.description: Output image dimensions as 'WIDTHxHEIGHT' or 'auto'. Default is 'auto'. GPT Image 2 and 2.5 models accept custom dimensions (multiples of 16, longer side ≤ 3840, total pixels 655,360–8,294,400, aspect ratio ≤ 3:1). Common presets — 1K: '1024x1024', '1536x1024', '1024x1536', '1792x1024', '1024x1792'; 2K: '2048x2048', '2048x1536', '1536x2048', '2048x1152', '1152x2048'; 4K: '2880x2880', '3264x2448', '2448x3264', '3840x2160', '2160x3840'. dall-e-2: '256x256', '512x512', '1024x1024'.
size.title: Size

n.description: Number of images to generate (1-10). Default is 1.
n.title: N

background.description: Background handling. 'transparent' removes background, 'opaque' keeps it, 'auto' decides automatically.
background.title: Background

input_fidelity.description: How closely to follow the reference image. 'high' preserves more detail, 'low' allows more creative freedom.
input_fidelity.title: Input Fidelity

response_format.description: How to return the image. 'url' (default) returns a URL, 'b64_json' returns base64-encoded image data.
response_format.title: Response Format

output_compression.description: Compression level (0-100%) for jpeg/webp output. Default is 100.
output_compression.title: Output Compression

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL. When provided, returns task_id immediately and POSTs result to this URL when complete.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

async.description: Whether to process the request asynchronously.
async.title: Async

tools.name: openai_list_image_models
tools.description: List this adapter's GPT Image model IDs from the pinned dependency schema. No API generation request; model entitlement and prices must be checked separately.

tools.name: openai_get_task
tools.description:
Retrieve a single async image task by its task ID or custom trace ID.

    Image generation and editing requests are submitted asynchronously and
    return a task_id immediately. Use this tool to poll until the task
    finishes and to retrieve the final image URLs.

    A task is complete once it carries a `finished_at` timestamp. While it is
    still running this tool waits ~5s before returning, so repeated calls
    poll at a sane rate.

    Use this when:
    - You called openai_generate_image or openai_edit_image and got a task_id
    - You want to check the status of an async image task

    Returns:
        JSON object with task details (id, trace_id, type, request, response,
        created_at, started_at, finished_at, elapsed) or an empty object if not found.

id.description: Task ID returned by the original image request (e.g. from openai_generate_image or openai_edit_image). At least one of 'id' or 'trace_id' must be provided.
id.title: Id

trace_id.description: Custom trace ID supplied via the 'trace_id' field on the original image request. When both 'id' and 'trace_id' are given, 'trace_id' takes precedence.
trace_id.title: Trace Id
